WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.avg_pulse
  FROM telescope_avgs ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > overall_avg.overall_avg
),
second_threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT ao.avg_pulse
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN second_threshold st
  WHERE ao.avg_pulse > st.second_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse - oa.overall_avg) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse - st.second_avg) as avg_above_second
FROM final_telescopes ft
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN second_threshold st
